description: Agent preflight round 3: check your own approval and escalation arrangement before an agent spends under it. Input text, fields (approvers as text or bands of {approver, from, up_to, required}, dual_control, fallback, expiry, currency) or both. The signed report lays the amount bands end to end from zero, states who approves each band and whether it takes two approvers, and names each gap plainly: an amount range no one approves, a single approver with no ceiling, the agent approving itself with no ceiling, no dual-control threshold, no fallback when the approver is unavailable, and approvals that never expire. POST /api/approval-chain-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The arrangement by element. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that element.

anyOf.description: Who or what approves spending at which amounts, as written.

approver.description: Who approves this band: a person, a role or the agent itself. Name each approver for joint approval, for example "CFO and CEO".

from.description: Optional lowest amount of the band. Defaults to 0.

required.description: Optional number of approvers who must approve; 2 or more is dual control.

up_to.description: Optional highest amount of the band. Leave it out for a band with no ceiling.

approvers.description: The approval bands: the arrangement as text, or up to 20 bands, each as text or {approver, from, up_to, required}.

currency.description: Optional currency or asset for amounts sent as numbers, for example "USDC" or "USD".

dual_control.description: When two or more approvers are required, for example "Two approvers above 10,000 USD".

expiry.description: When an approval lapses, for example "Approvals expire after 72 hours".

fallback.description: Who approves or how spending escalates when the usual approver is unavailable.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The approval and escalation arrangement as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_approval-chain-check
title: Approval chain check
